headline: Utah and Maine to cover Native traditional healing in Medicaid
pages: The Trump administration has approved waivers that let Utah and Maine pay for traditional healing for Native American Medicaid enrollees, KFF Health News reported on Nov. 18. HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced the approvals in September.

The approvals come as the administration prepares rules expected to remove millions of people from Medicaid. The waivers matter because they widen the kinds of care Medicaid can cover for Native communities even as federal limits grow.
